authorization: current user authorizes bounded public-data analysis

config.contrasts: None: do not pair repeat numbers across treatment arms or calculate prediction accuracy
config.eligibility: Public cell-line count table, 15 source samples across five conditions with three reported repeats; independent initiation and cross-arm pairing are unverified
config.endpoint: For each source condition, gene-average sample variance (ddof=1) of log2(1+1e6*count/whole-column-count-total), retaining every source gene row
config.gene_selection: All unique source gene IDs, including all-zero rows; no response filtering or fitted transformation
config.missingness: Refuse missing/duplicate identities, ambiguous metadata mappings, nonfinite/negative counts, zero column totals, or a missing condition/repeat; no imputation
config.outcomes_exposed_before_registration: Published study narrative, source sample metadata; no count matrix parsed
config.promotion: This diagnostic cannot nominate a predictor or pass biological readiness; custodian lineage, dose/vehicle and rights evidence remain necessary
config.purpose: Descriptive within-condition variation of source-reported repeat measurements, not a predictor evaluation or biological confirmation
config.rights_basis: Public GEO access and local research reuse under GEO disclaimer; no assertion of blanket submitter/derivative redistribution rights
config.uncertainty: No biological confidence intervals, power calculation, significance test or useful-effect threshold from three unverified repeat labels
config.units: RSEM-derived source counts may be fractional; preserve float64 values without rounding
